message.enchant_plus.updated_core: [Enchant Plus] Updated to v1.1.4. The help command is /trigger ep_help.
message.enchant_plus.help.title: Enchant Plus v1.1.4 | Minecraft Java 26.2
message.enchant_plus.help.enchantments: • Anvil combinations (vanilla level caps): Sharpness/Smite/Bane; all four Protections; Mending/Infinity; Multishot/Piercing; and Density/Breach/Sharpness/Smite/Bane on maces
message.enchant_plus.help.wingbound: • Wingbound: combine 1 chestplate + 1 elytra in a crafting grid (not an anvil)
message.enchant_plus.help.wingbound_sepa: • Separate: press Q to place a Wingbound Chestplate on top of a grindstone (returns both items)
message.enchant_plus.help.anvil: • Cost reset: press Q to drop an item with +1 or more prior-work cost and 1 Nether Star onto the same anvil top
message.enchant_plus.help.anvil_cost: • The shown value is Minecraft's prior-work penalty; +0 is hidden
message.enchant_plus.anvil.hint: [Enchant Plus] Press Q to drop an item with +1 or more prior-work cost and 1 Nether Star onto the same anvil top.
message.enchant_plus.anvil.success: [Enchant Plus] Consumed 1 Nether Star and reset the prior-work penalty.
message.enchant_plus.wingbound.separated: [Enchant Plus] Separated the Wingbound Chestplate into its chestplate and elytra.
